name: Calgary Please Be Quiet 2026
information: #### Blindfolded Events Only The only events at this competition are blindfolded events, which require a significant amount of practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. #### FMC Canada 2026 FMC Canada 2026 (Calgary location) will take place at the same venue. If you are registering for both competitions, you must register for each competition separately. only pay for one competition. #### Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation 2k6), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for another competition if this one isn't for you. ##### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
